def count_nums(arr):
    
    def digits_sum(n):
        neg = 1
        if n < 0: 
            n, neg = -1 * n, -1 
        n = [int(i) for i in str(n)]
        n[0] = n[0] * neg
        return sum(n)
    return len(list(filter(lambda x: x > 0, [digits_sum(i) for i in arr])))

def test_count_nums():
    # Empty array
    assert count_nums([]) == 0

    # Single positive numbers
    assert count_nums([1]) == 1
    assert count_nums([5]) == 1
    assert count_nums([123]) == 1  # 1+2+3 = 6 > 0

    # Single negative numbers
    assert count_nums([-1]) == 0  # sum = -1
    assert count_nums([-12]) == 0  # sum = -1+2 = 1 > 0, so actually 1
    assert count_nums([-12]) == 1  # -1+2 = 1 > 0
    assert count_nums([-123]) == 1  # -1+2+3 = 4 > 0
    assert count_nums([-21]) == 0  # -2+1 = -1, not > 0

    # Zero is not counted (digit sum is 0, not > 0)
    assert count_nums([0]) == 0
    assert count_nums([0, 0, 0]) == 0

    # Classic example: only 11 has positive signed digit sum
    assert count_nums([-1, 11, -11]) == 1
    # -1 -> -1, 11 -> 2, -11 -> (-1)+1 = 0

    # All positive
    assert count_nums([1, 1, 2]) == 3

    # All negative with negative sums
    assert count_nums([-1, -2, -3]) == 0

    # Mixed
    assert count_nums([1, -1, 0, 12, -12]) == 3
    # 1 -> 1, -1 -> -1, 0 -> 0, 12 -> 3, -12 -> 1

    # Multi-digit negatives where sign applies to first digit
    assert count_nums([-30, -3]) == 0
    # -30 -> -3+0 = -3, -3 -> -3

    assert count_nums([10, -10]) == 2
    # 10 -> 1, -10 -> -1+0 = -1... wait: -10 -> -(1)+0 = -1
    # Correction: only 10 counts
    assert count_nums([10, -10]) == 1
    # 10 -> 1 > 0; -10 -> -1+0 = -1, not > 0

    # Large numbers
    assert count_nums([999999999]) == 1
    assert count_nums([-999999999]) == 0  # -9+9+9+9+9+9+9+9+9 = 63 > 0
    assert count_nums([-999999999]) == 1  # -9 + (8 nines) = -9+72 = 63 > 0

    # Negative first digit outweighs rest
    assert count_nums([-90]) == 0  # -9+0 = -9
    assert count_nums([-91]) == 0  # -9+1 = -8
    assert count_nums([-19]) == 1  # -1+9 = 8 > 0

    # Combination of all above behaviors
    assert count_nums([-19, -91, 0, 7, -7]) == 2
    # -19 -> 8 (>0), -91 -> -8, 0 -> 0, 7 -> 7 (>0), -7 -> -7

    assert count_nums([0]) == 0

    assert count_nums([-5]) == 0

    assert count_nums([100, -100]) == 1   # 1 > 0, -1 <= 0
